surfaces.name: construction-fidelity
surfaces.judge_prompt: Given a synthetic-expert GENESIS descriptor (hat, domain, subdomain, beautiful_question, research_approach, lens_count, distinct_source_count), classify it faithful (a valid de Bono hat, a coherent domain and subdomain, a GENUINE beautiful-question derived from the lens, a research-approach that cites the multi-lens fan-out, at least two lenses, and more than one distinct source) or hollow (any breach). A hollow construction is a costume and fails independently of how it later answers.

surfaces.name: behavioral-fidelity
surfaces.judge_prompt: Given a synthetic INVOKED-skill transcript (hat, domain, prompt, response, in_lens, grounded, off_role), classify it faithful (in-character reasoning from the hat and domain lens, grounded in the RS expert-graph it reads, answering in-role, with no Part-8 leak and no banned dash) or costume (any breach: out-of-lens drift, an ungrounded claim, an off-role answer, a Part-8 leak, or a banned dash).

phase_gate: BOTH surfaces must pass. A costume that only answers one prompt well FAILS surface A (construction) independently of surface B (behavior). The phase closes on both local parity gates green plus this baseline_deferred recorded, OR both live via /evals:eval (fable). Plurai-scored, not grep-scored: Plan 01 genesis iterates until both are green.
